question: I want to see everything — stocks AND crypto AND forex — that just broke out above their 20-day moving average with rising volume. Cross-market breakouts.
result_summary: Returned 80 results (capped=true). Top 20 include 5 crypto (.CC: WZRD-USD.CC, ADM-USD.CC, ALPH-USD.CC, BLESS-USD.CC, AIFUN-USD.CC) and 15 stocks (JWEL.US, MKTSF.US, 0420.HK, GENL.LSE, RHK.XETRA, NTV.LSE, TLRY.US, 084110.KQ, 0756.HK, 600095.CG, etc.). No forex (.FOREX) in top 20 — forex pairs likely have no volume data series, or volume_dryup is the norm for FX. Both the breakout (cross_close_ema20_up) and rising_volume signals confirmed in matched output. Multi-asset (stocks + crypto) confirmed.
reason: Returns results from two asset types (stocks + crypto) with both the MA breakout and volume conditions confirmed. However, no forex appears in results despite being included in the universe — forex pairs may lack volume data, which is a known limitation not surfaced to the client.

defects.desc: Forex is included in asset_type but returns zero forex pairs for a volume-conditioned screen. Forex pairs typically have no tradeable volume data (FX is OTC). The server should warn the client that volume-based conditions do not apply to forex/currency assets, or automatically exclude them with a note rather than silently returning no forex results.
